name: Cannery Hall

bagPolicy.summary: Purses and other bags must be smaller than 12 × 12 inches and are searched. Backpacks, large bags and tote bags are prohibited.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The venue reports paid parking close to the building but does not publish a specific lot name or price on its FAQ.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by Cannery Hall. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: The venue has bars that remain open as long as practical during shows. Outside food and beverages are prohibited.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: The box office handles ADA arrangements. Guests seeking an accommodation should contact the venue and arrive 10–15 minutes before doors.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: Guests aged 21 or older may re-enter except at all-ages shows; those shows have no re-entry. Bags are searched again on return.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: The box office is at 1 Cannery Row. Buy tickets only through canneryhall.com or the box office, since tickets from other sites are not guaranteed. If a show hasn't sold out, you can buy tickets at the box office before the show and during it.

gates.summary: Doors open at the time printed on the concert ticket. The entrance is at 1 Cannery Row, and guests may line up at the front on show day.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

capacity: Mainstage up to 1,275 standing; The Mil 550; Row One 300; Amaranth 380
